name: Necromancer: Raised Gargoyle attacks with Putrid Claw (#4156)
contract: Without a Command a Raised Gargoyle only auto-attacks and uses Putrid Claw; Command: Gargoyle is cast on order only. Command: Gargoyle (707598) triggers Bone Toss (704706, 5 s) on its target, and nothing else the Gargoyle casts does, so Bone Toss stays absent from the target throughout an unordered 10 s fight (the old auto-cast, every 3 s, kept it up) and appears once the Necromancer orders Command: Gargoyle (504052, 50 Runic Power). The Necromancer's spell hit rating, which the Gargoyle inherits, keeps the order's miss chance at the 1% floor, and the order is given twice. The Gargoyle occupies 3 Life Force, so the Necromancer first learns Scourge Apprentice Training (680283, +1 Life Force over the base 2).
